# DisasterWatch - FEMA Disaster Declaration Monitoring Tool

DisasterWatch is a web application that helps property managers, landlords, insurance agents, and contractors monitor FEMA disaster declarations in their operational areas.

## Key Features:
- Real-time monitoring of FEMA disaster declarations
- Track counties across multiple states 
- Email and SMS alerts when new disasters are declared
- Access to official FEMA record information and assistance programs
- 3-county free tier, unlimited counties on paid plan

## Main Sections:
- Home page with county selector
- Dashboard showing watched counties and alert feed
- Pricing page with free and paid tiers
- About page explaining the service and its usage

## Target Keywords:
FEMA disaster declaration alert
disaster declaration tracker by county
FEMA assistance program alerts
property manager disaster monitoring tool

The site uses:
- React + Tailwind CSS for front-end
- Supabase for user authentication and data storage  
- Stripe for payment processing
- FEMA OpenFEMA API for disaster data
